name: SLAIN_GOAT
canonical: the slain goat of the sin offering, a young Near-Eastern male goat with smooth dark-and-white hair and small horns, lying killed beside the bronze altar of the tabernacle, its lifeblood gathered into a bronze basin to be carried behind the veil, set against the smoke and gold of the tabernacle court
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
